chapter: Traditional style, ragtime orchestra and closing questions
title: What Wood likes in traditional New Orleans music
summary: Wood values restraint, melody and accessibility in traditional music and dislikes the Dukes of Dixieland as lacking depth.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
